environment.profile: fresh disposable normal profile; unsigned-in; Sync disabled
environment.cleanupMode: Standard detailed review with the two-activation missing-access handoff

limitations: This is one narrow installed-browser observation retained to verify that the exact-artifact cleanup completed and emitted a finite duration; it is not a representative benchmark or a cleanup-speed claim.
Brave cleanup timing, larger fixtures, repeated distributions, cold-worker starts, private mode, Expert mode, and adverse browser-load conditions remain deferred follow-up measurements.

The runtime report exposed the end-to-end installed cleanup duration but did not retain a separately instrumented internal phase breakdown, so the single phase value deliberately represents the same whole installed cleanup.
Node test duration is not used as browser cleanup performance.
